mapper.sql: ( COALESCE(username, '') || CHR(1) || COALESCE(client_ip, '') || CHR(1) || COALESCE(request_uri, '') || CHR(1) || COALESCE(query_string, '') || CHR(1) || COALESCE(user_agent, '') )
mapper.delete: WITH target AS (SELECT id FROM access_log WHERE access_time < #{cutoff} ORDER BY access_time, id LIMIT #{limit}) DELETE FROM access_log WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_log WHERE access_time < #{cutoff}

SELECT id, username, client_ip AS clientIp, request_uri AS requestUri, method, user_agent AS userAgent, access_time AS accessTime, query_string AS queryString, request_body AS requestBody, response_status AS responseStatus, execute_time AS executeTime, referer, audit_action AS auditAction, audit_target AS auditTarget, audit_description AS auditDescription FROM access_log WHERE access_time < #{cutoff} ORDER BY access_time, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, username, client_ip AS clientIp, request_uri AS requestUri, method, user_agent AS userAgent, access_time AS accessTime, query_string AS queryString, request_body AS requestBody, response_status AS responseStatus, execute_time AS executeTime, referer, audit_action AS auditAction, audit_target AS auditTarget, audit_description AS auditDescription FROM access_log
AND username LIKE '%' || #{username} || '%'
AND client_ip LIKE '%' || #{clientIp} || '%'
AND request_uri LIKE '%' || #{requestUri} || '%'
AND method = #{method}
AND response_status LIKE #{responseStatus} || '%'
AND access_time >= CAST(#{startTime} AS timestamp)
AND access_time <= CAST(#{endTime} AS timestamp)
ORDER BY access_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, username, client_ip AS clientIp, request_uri AS requestUri, method, user_agent AS userAgent, access_time AS accessTime, query_string AS queryString, request_body AS requestBody, response_status AS responseStatus, execute_time AS executeTime, referer, audit_action AS auditAction, audit_target AS auditTarget, audit_description AS auditDescription FROM access_log
AND (access_time, id) < (#{cursorAccessTime}, #{cursorId})
AND username LIKE '%' || #{username} || '%' AND client_ip LIKE '%' || #{clientIp} || '%' AND request_uri LIKE '%' || #{requestUri} || '%' AND method = #{method} AND response_status LIKE #{responseStatus} || '%' AND access_time >= CAST(#{startTime} AS timestamp) AND access_time <= CAST(#{endTime} AS timestamp)
ORDER BY access_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
